infobox.usage: Unlocks Shturman's stash in the sawmill area on Woods.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Shturman's stash key (SSK) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The Svetloozersk gang's common fund stash key, usually kept by Shturman. The key looks very flimsy, it could break from even a single use.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be found in raid for the quest The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: In the sawmill area on Woods, on top of a tire next to a wood log pile.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - The contents of the Common fund stash.
